notes.title: Version 0.0.2
notes.content: [p][b]New Enemy Behavior[/b][/p][p]Enemy behavior has been upgraded with tactical decisions based on positioning. Most enemies can now only attack while in front, allowing the player to disrupt them with Dizzy spells. But watch out for Ranged enemies who can attack from anywhere. All fights have been rebalanced and new room modifiers have been added to give each fight a more unique twist.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Character - Necromancer[/b][/p][p]The Necromancer has awoken. Features a dangerous playstyle based around sacrificing health and unique healing mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Character and Spell Overhaul[/b][/p][p]All spells and starting decks have been rebalanced to give each character a more unique playstyle. Rewards have been updated to give higher stakes to your decisions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]User Interface[/b][/p][p]Game speed can now be adjusted to allow a faster pace of play. Many quality of life upgrades have been made to give the player more feedback while planning their turn.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1.4
notes.content:
Tiny patch
[list]
[*] Added clearer UI for casting/discard
[*] Slight Adjustment to elite fight placement
[/list]

We are noticing a lot of players rushing to elites and dying. To alleviate this, we added an extra fight before the elites that are close (<2 fights before reaching the elite).

Thanks
-G/B

notes.title: Small update: version 0.0.1.3
notes.content:
Pluto version 0.0.1.3 is live! 

We noticed the feral orc shaman had a 0% win rate so we’ve adjusted that fight. 

New fights have been added across the map and we’ve made some adjustments to spells. 

We’ve also added a lot of small quality of life updates, mostly focused on giving you better feedback from the spells in your hand and making them easier to manage. we recommend replaying the updated tutorial to get better acquainted.

Thanks -G/B

notes.title: Doom Fix
notes.content: Doom was doing too much damage... we have greatly nerfed the damage

notes.title: Feedback Fix
notes.content:
We had an error with our feedback system since launching the playtest. This error has been fixed and we would appreciate getting your feedback (again).

Thanks,
-B/G
